anomalies.detail: compression depth is not uniform across this prefix: 11 file(s) at 1 layer(s) (2026-07-06 → 2026-07-20); 501 file(s) at 2 layer(s) (2024-07-03 → 2026-07-02). A reader that decompresses a fixed number of times fails on one group or the other; unwrap until the DBN magic appears.

raw/opra_definition/condition.json documents data condition only to 2026-07-03, but the prefix holds files through 2026-07-20. The later files come from a separate vendor job and have no condition record; note this lines up with the change in compression depth.

compression depth is not uniform across this prefix: 11 file(s) at 1 layer(s) (2026-07-06 → 2026-07-20); 501 file(s) at 2 layer(s) (2024-07-03 → 2026-07-02). A reader that decompresses a fixed number of times fails on one group or the other; unwrap until the DBN magic appears.

6 file(s) under raw/trades/NQ/ carry DBN query symbol ES.FUT, i.e. they hold ES data, not NQ. 6 of them duplicate the ES/ file of the same date (identical DBN metadata). Reading these as NQ silently substitutes ES prices. All 6 date(s) are superseded in config/exclusions.yaml, so nothing reads them.
NQ: 1 trading session date(s) have no usable data after supersessions are applied: 2025-04-18. Classified from the CME_Equity calendar, so these are not holidays.
